profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | AI Systems & Agent Evaluation | AI Safety Research
profile.summary: Fullstack Software Engineer with expertise across the modern stack - specializing in Angular and Ruby to deliver scalable web and mobile applications across the Healthcare, AI, and SaaS industries. Recently focused on building AI powered conversational intelligence tools that empower data driven decisions, capture leads and deliver a meaningful customer experience. Known for combining seasoned technical skills with a business driven mindset to create high impact customer results.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and build evaluation systems for production conversational AI and voice agents, translating high-level product goals into technical architecture and working software.
Own the design and implementation of agent evaluation frameworks, including evaluation workflows, grading logic, and review outputs.
Combine LLM-based assessment with deterministic checks to evaluate agent behavior against defined requirements.
Investigate production logs and interaction patterns to identify failures and inform prompt, configuration, and product improvements.
Build tools that make evaluation findings actionable for engineering, product, and ML collaborators.
Partner across disciplines to define evaluation criteria, explain technical decisions, and prioritize improvements to agent reliability.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Built and maintained AI-powered Conversational Intelligence features across CallRail’s Angular and Ruby applications.
Developed frontend and backend functionality supporting the processing and presentation of AI-generated insights.
Evaluated LLM outputs and refined prompts to improve accuracy and alignment with product requirements.
Integrated AI capabilities into customer-facing workflows.
Collaborated with product managers, designers, and engineers to translate business needs into software features.

positions.title: AI Safety Fellow
positions.description:
Conducted AI safety research on information integrity and cultural fidelity in AI-assisted journalism, focusing on reporting about Black and diaspora communities.
Developed a structured evaluation framework for identifying unsupported claims, cultural distortions, attribution loss, and context loss.
Built EvalLab, a research platform supporting configurable experiments, rubric-based evaluation, and reproducible records.
Conducted 223 evaluations across baseline transformation tasks and adversarial editorial pressures.
Examined how compression, engagement optimization, certainty, institutional softening, and global reframing affect generated content.
Completed technical training through the ARENA curriculum, covering transformer architectures, mechanistic interpretability, and AI evaluation.

positions.title: Technical Curriculum Developer & Community Engagement Manager
Web Developer
positions.description: Create Web applications utilizing HTML, CSS, Node, React and Rails. Consult junior web developers and provide useful feedback on projects.

positions.title: WDI Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
I assist with the design, development, and execution of the Interapt Skills Web Development program. 
I developed and taught curriculum on: MongoDB, Express, React and Node as well as PostgreSQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, RESTful API and AJAX to a class of 25 Junior developers.

positions.title: Web Development Immersive Fellow
positions.description: General Assembly’s Web Development Immersive (WDI) is a 12-week long training program dedicated to give students a deep dive into the world of web development, focusing on web development tools such as: Git/Github, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node, MongoDB, SQL, and Ruby on Rails.

positions.title: Contract Administrator
positions.description:
Managed the State and Local Government contracts for IBM’s Global Finance unit. Analyzed and
processed contracts while mitigating risk and ensuring legal compliance.

positions.title: AmazonFresh Transportation Operations Specialist
positions.description:
Monitored the daily logistic operations of hubs delivering AmazonFresh orders. Investigated order delays
and promptly informed internal teams and customers.

positions.title: Federal Consultant
positions.description:
Researched and evaluated over 300 new and existing drug applications requesting FDA approval.
Responsible for the accuracy and compliance of applications.

positions.title: Business Analyst
positions.description:
Ensured software quality by performing unit testing and tracking defects in the HP Quality Center (Application
Lifecycle ). Responsible for compiling and reporting the results collected from software testing.

positions.title: Alliances Intern, Product Strategy and Management
positions.description:
Assist Vice President of Alliance division with the development and implementation of special projects such as revitalizing the annual Primary Partner revenue report and the execution of the Deltek annual Insight Customer Conference
Research and analyze financial reports to find partner metrics on units sold, revenue, royalty payments, and margins on Deltek products to track success of sales and partnerships
Compose and update partner records in Salesforce.com to maintain and strengthen strategic alliances between Deltek and partners
Formulate MS Excel spreadsheets and compute quarterly and annual products units sold, pipeline, prepay balances, margins on license and maintenance across 20-25 partners to remain cognizant of account balances 
Develop MS PowerPoint slides, pivot tables,  and compose briefing documents to be presented during partner meetings and Deltek Executive meetings 
Communicate the status of partner inquiries to applicants regarding their potential partnership with Deltek
Manage meeting schedules, and calendars for Vice President of Alliances
